The Router's severity ratings are well-calibrated; the text issue is the most prominent defect, followed by the pervasive texture artificiality. No major artifacts were missed, though the texture issue is widespread enough to arguably warrant a slightly higher severity consideration, but 2 is defensible given the items are still recognizable as pastries.
